subject: [PATCH v4 18/19] selftests/mm: add memory-pressure threads to the khugepaged race harness

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds two new threads to the khugepaged race harness: pageout and compactor. The pageout thread simulates memory pressure by cycling MADV_PAGEOUT on a dedicated neighbour region, while the compactor thread triggers compaction by writing to /proc/sys/vm/compact_memory in a loop. These threads are added to test how the khugepaged collapse interacts with memory pressure and compaction. The patch also updates the harness to run every mode and occupancy limit both with and without these new threads.
